title: H002: Add multi-stage Dockerfile for deployment
summary: Multi-stage Dockerfile is well-architected with proper security (non-root, distroless, static binary), module caching, multi-platform support, and comprehensive test coverage. One blocking issue: the test_version_args_injected test calls `plexd version` (subcommand) but only `plexd --version` (flag) exists, causing the test to always fail. Documentation also references a nonexistent `version` subcommand.

tests_checklist.item: Test covers module cache layer ordering

code_quality_checklist.item: Test script is well-structured with pass/fail/cleanup
No dead code or unnecessary complexity

security_checklist.item: Base images use specific version tags (not :latest)

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is as simple as possible
Build args correctly wired to main.go ldflags
Ports match README and Kubernetes manifests

fail_fast_checklist.item: Test script exits on build failure

defensive_checklist.item: Makefile git commands have fallback defaults
Hadolint gracefully skipped if not installed

issues_found.description: test_version_args_injected calls `plexd version` (subcommand) but no `version` subcommand exists. Only `plexd --version` (flag) works via cobra's Version field. The test will always fail — `plexd version` returns 'Error: unknown command' and the grep for '1.0.0-test' never matches.
Documentation references nonexistent `version` subcommand in the entrypoint section.
issues_found.fix: Change 'Pass any subcommand as arguments: `up`, `join`, `status`, `version`, etc.' to 'Pass any subcommand as arguments: `up`, `join`, `status`, etc. Use `--version` flag for version info.'

suggested_improvements: Consider pinning the distroless base image to a specific digest for fully reproducible builds (e.g., gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12@sha256:...)
The test_dockerignore_excludes_git test uses alpine:3.21 without digest pinning — acceptable for test-only use but worth noting
next_steps: Fix test_dockerfile.sh:80 — change `version` subcommand to `--version` flag
Fix docs/reference/backend/dockerfile.md:115 — remove `version` from subcommand list, note `--version` flag instead
